# Marky v1.9.0

A calm, considered redesign for everyday reading and writing — the Quiet Desk update.

### Quiet Desk redesign

- **Unified surface.** The title bar and sidebar now share one continuous, seamless tone with no harsh dividing hairlines, allowing the editor sheet to take center stage.
- **Typeface selection.** Choose between **Sans** (Hanken Grotesk, the new crisp modern default), **Serif** (Newsreader, tailored for long-form reading and reflection), or **Mixed** (Newsreader prose paired with JetBrains Mono for code blocks). All variable font files are self-hosted and bundled locally with zero network dependency.
- **Matching typography.** Heading proportions, margins, line heights, font sizes, and quote styling have been harmonized between Live Preview and Read modes, ensuring text doesn't shift or jump when switching views.
- **Quiet tabs.** Tabs are now styled as gentle, unbordered pills that lift onto the page surface when active.
- **Smooth tab overflow fade & blur.** When tabs scroll past the title bar edges, they gracefully dissolve with a directional gradient mask and subtle edge blur instead of clipping abruptly. Vertical mouse wheel scrolling is translated into horizontal tab scroll.
- **Generous title bar spacing.** Clear separation between the tab list and the Source/Live/Read mode switch so actions never feel crowded or fixed into tabs.
- **Unobtrusive scrollbars.** Scrollbars remain completely hidden until you actively scroll, keeping documents calm and distraction-free at rest.
- **macOS alignment.** macOS window controls (traffic lights) are now cleanly centered with the title bar buttons.

### Editor

- **Sticky view mode.** Marky remembers your last active view mode (Source, Live, or Read) across note switches and app restarts.
